<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—a dominant M peak with successive M+1, M+2, etc., decreasing roughly by a factor of ~10 each step, matching the natural 13C abundance (~1.1% per carbon) and no distinct M+2 peak characteristic of Cl, Br, S, etc.—the only element that can be definitively identified from the isotope distribution is carbon.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
